note: Finding: From the stage budgets, `Deployment.recloses` proves ℰ_m ≤ `Calendar.allowance` m = ε_m^reg, 𝒦_m ≤ e^{−g_j (M^cut_{m+1})²} ≤ `Calendar.forcedAllowance` m = ε_m^for, and t_m²|Δ| ≤ H ⇒ |Δ| ≤ 1, and `DirectedRecipe.reload` carries these bounds into the retained output. No declaration bounds ℰ_m or 𝒦_m by a 1/1024 fraction of the allowances, which [M] prints.

verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `\mathcal E_m\le\epsilon_m^{\rm reg}/1024,\qquad \mathcal K_m\le\epsilon_m^{\rm for}/1024`.
evidence: [M] prints t_m^2|Delta| <= H_j, E_m <= eps^reg_m/1024, K_m <= eps^for_m/1024, |Delta| <= 1 with eps^reg_m = refbeta_m^{-11/10}, eps^for_m = exp(-M_m^{1/5}) (appendix-constants.tex:55-56). [L]'s recloses concludes `P.EBound (a.budget m) (C.allowance m)` and `P.KBound (a.budget m) (C.forcedAllowance m)` with allowance = (sqrt hatBeta)^{-11/5} = eps^reg and forcedAllowance = exp(-monitor^{1/5}) = eps^for, and reload carries exactly these into `Valid u.p (allowance m) (forcedAllowance m)`; the Delta bounds match. No declaration bounds E_m or K_m by allowance/1024 (the only 1/1024 constants in [L] are unrelated `a'` in clock assemblies and spectral 1/2^10; the nearest sharper bound is 1/2*allowance in Extra/ITERATION_NO_LOSS/Local.lean:35), so the 1/1024 factors are missing and the claim stands. Not a typo: [M]'s proofs (D-section.tex:510, 518, 740-744) deliberately derive the /1024 margins.

[M] prints t_m^2|Delta| <= H_j, E_m <= eps_m^reg/1024, K_m <= eps_m^for/1024, |Delta| <= 1, with eps_m^reg = hatbeta_m^{-11/10} and eps_m^for = exp(-(monitor_m)^{1/5}) (Section 3). In [L], Calendar.allowance m = (sqrt hatBeta m)^{-1}^(11/5) = eps^reg and forcedAllowance m = eps^for exactly, and recloses concludes only `P.EBound (a.budget m) (C.allowance m)` and `P.KBound (a.budget m) (C.forcedAllowance m)` (plus t'^2|Delta| <= H -> |Delta| <= 1); the upstream source BandGate.budgets gives only `... < δE x` with δE x = gap x^(11/5), again without a 1/1024 factor, and reload packages exactly these bounds into `Valid ... (allowance m) (forcedAllowance m)`. No declaration in [L] states E_m or K_m against allowance/1024 (the only 1/1024 and /2048 constants in [L] concern unrelated clocks and curvature budgets), so [L] proves the shape with a constant 1024 times worse. Not a typo: [M] derives the 1/1024 deliberately in the proofs of Lemma D1 (D-section.tex:510, 518, 740-744) and uses it as stated.
